table_row: A directly precedes B; B directly precedes C | Infer A precedes C; do not infer the direct shortcut from these axioms
narrative: Given a chain of two proposed directlyPrecedes edges (A to B, B to C), the transitive superproperty precedes must entail A precedes C. The candidate axioms in the decision document do not entail A directlyPrecedes C, and no test may assert that shortcut.
